1.
Leave granted.
2.
These are the cases of the original owners where
neither  possession  has  been  taken  nor  compensation
has been paid to the respondents.
3.
It is also brought to the notice of the court
that there was no stay operating, which prevented the

Page 2
JUDGMENT
appellant(s)  from  taking  possession  or  paying
compensation to the respondents.
4.
Neither having been done within five years, as
contemplated under Section 24(2) of The Right to Fair
Compensation  and  Transparency  in  Land  Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, we find no
merit  in  these  appeals,  which  are,  accordingly,
dismissed.
No costs.
